title: Danny Welbeck agrees one-year Brighton contract extension through to 2027
content:
Danny Welbeck has agreed a one-year contract extension with Brighton & Hove Albion as he closes in on sharing a Premier League goal scoring record.

The 35-year-old striker’s existing deal, due to expire at the end of the season, includes a 12-month extension option which has been triggered.

Welbeck has scored in successive league wins at Brentford (2-0) and at home to Nottingham Forest (2-1) to reach ten goals in consecutive seasons, a career-best tally.

One more goal would make him only the third player to score more than ten goals in a Premier League season for the first time while aged 35 or older after Gary McAllister for Coventry City in 1999-2000 and Zlatan Ibrahimovic (both 35) for Manchester United in 2016-17.

Welbeck faces league leaders Arsenal, one of his former clubs, at the Amex Stadium on Wednesday night.

The ex-Manchester United and England veteran has scored 11 times across all competitions and 48 goals in 191 appearances in total for Brighton since signing from Watford on a free transfer in October 2020.

A prolific run of seven goals in as many games in September and October prompted calls for Welbeck to be recalled by England coach Thomas Tuchel in the build-up to this summer’s World Cup amid a shortage at the time of No 9 alternatives to Harry Kane.

Welbeck is part of a leadership group of experienced players at Brighton under head coach Fabian Hurzeler which also includes Jason Steele (35), 34-year-olds Lewis Dunk, Pascal Gross and Joel Veltman, plus 40-year-old James Milner.

Milner has started the last two games, breaking Gareth Barry’s Premier League appearances record by reaching 654 matches in the Brentford win.

Hurzeler named an unchanged line-up in the Forest victory, repeating Brighton’s oldest starting X1 of the season which stood at an average age of 28 years and 355 days at Brentford.

Welbeck and the other experienced campaigners have helped Brighton get back on track in 11th place after one win in 13 league games dropped them to 14th.
